intro_meme.prompt: A cartoon gas pump nozzle trembles and sweats nervously in its holster before anyone's even picked it up, a red warning siren light spinning on top of the pump, the price display still dark with a glowing 'LOADING...' spinner, teasing a big reveal.

outro_meme.prompt: A cartoon hand stamps a glowing 'FULL STORY INSIDE' stamp onto a long unrolled paper receipt, then folds the whole receipt into a paper airplane and launches it straight at the camera.

sources.fact: USDA AMS: national average diesel hit a record $6.285/gal for the week ending Sep 14, 2026 — up 31.8 cents week-over-week, 254.6 cents above the same week last year.
USDA AMS ties the spike to a specific cause: shipping through the Strait of Hormuz has dropped to its lowest level since the U.S.-Iran conflict began, squeezing global fuel supply.
